# Quotation -- Technical maintenance services, Rautavaara industrial estate (TKR-RFQ-2026-07)

**Bidder:** Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla

## 2. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy meets all stated eligibility requirements. The company holds a valid LUSA qualification (LVI- ja sahkourakointi, valid to 2027-03-31) and a valid F-gas regulation qualification (valid to 2028-01-31) for refrigeration and air-conditioning work. Visakoivu Oy fields a substantial in-house LVI workforce of 105 qualified professionals, well in excess of the required minimum of 20, providing significant surge capacity across the estate's four buildings. The company holds a current Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate (valid to 2026-12-31) and has multiple reference projects exceeding EUR 300,000, including a EUR 1,650,000 framework agreement for Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue covering five health centres. The electrical team numbers 48 professionals, above the required 15.

## 3. Technical requirements

**3.1 Occupational safety plan:** Managed under our NMSB 75310:2018 system, with a site-specific safety plan for the multi-tenant estate covering induction, PPE requirements and permit-to-work procedures for hot work and confined spaces.

**3.2 Warranty period:** 24 months on installed equipment and materials.

**3.3 Lift maintenance:** Statutory inspection and maintenance managed through our lift partner network, documented in the digital maintenance log for each unit.

**3.4 Waste management:** Waste sorted on site per current regulations, with segregated collection points agreed with the estate manager.

**3.5 Spare parts:** Common parts typically available within 2-5 working days; discontinued equipment handled via equivalent-part sourcing or refurbishment assessment.

**3.6 Quality control:** NMSB 7310:2015-based inspection and sign-off for all completed work.

**3.7 Environmental management:** NMSB 74210:2015 procedures for emissions, noise and waste during works.

**3.8 Building envelope inspection:** Annual visual condition survey of roofing and cladding across all four buildings, with photographic record.

**3.9 Maintenance visit scheduling:** Scheduled visits set by system criticality and tenant operating hours, agreed with the estate manager in advance.

**3.10 Access and security:** Site access coordinated with each tenant's own security procedures, with 48 hours' notice as required.

**3.11 Reporting:** Monthly maintenance report to the Buyer's facilities contact, including outstanding items.

**3.12 Response times:** Tiered by severity, with 24/7 cover for critical shared-system faults.

**3.13 Asset register handover:** Existing documentation reviewed and incorporated into our CMMS at contract start, updated continuously thereafter.

**3.14 Corrective maintenance response:** Non-emergency requests addressed within agreed working-day windows by severity.

**3.15 Staff training:** Annual briefing for the Buyer's facilities staff on maintained systems.

**3.16 Subcontracting management:** Subcontracted trades selected against our approved-supplier list and supervised by our site lead.

**3.17 Escalation:** Unresolved faults escalated to the maintenance manager if the agreed response time is exceeded, with the Buyer notified.

## 4. Commercial terms

Bonus-malus arrangement proposed for service-level performance; price indexation per an agreed index with a stated reference month; standard payment terms accepted; monthly invoicing with e-invoicing capability; termination on 30 days' notice for material breach; pricing on a fixed monthly basis for shared-system maintenance; all prices in euro.

## 5. Enclosures

Reference form (Liite 2), certificate of pension insurance payments, certificate of tax payment, and quality system description are enclosed with this quotation.

## 6. Format

Minimum 11pt font used throughout; delivery channel and copy count confirmed separately; submission deadline noted as 16 October 2026, 14:00 Finnish time; pricing in euro; monetary figures to two decimal places.

## Annexes

We confirm acceptance of the qualification, method-statement and continuity requirements set out in Liite A, the discount and penalty terms in Liite B subject to final commercial agreement, and will enclose the confidentiality undertaking, power of attorney and trade register extract required under Liite C.

Visakoivu Oy is confident that its scale of in-house resource, certifications and reference portfolio make it a strong fit for the Rautavaara estate's shared-system maintenance scope, and looks forward to discussing this quotation further.
